title: Python Casting
description: Casting in Python is done using constructor functions: int(), float(), and str().
example:
x = int(1)   # x will be 1
y = int(2.8) # y will be 2
z = int("3") # z will be 3

challenges.title: Float to Int
challenges.exercise: Convert x = 2.8 into an integer and print it.

challenges.title: String to Float
challenges.exercise: Convert z = '3' into a float and print it.
